verdict: inner_ca and inner_s3 produce no record of the {tag, byte, 0x10f tail} family: each writes one tagged result struct through its first argument (tag 0 + six accumulated qwords on success, tag 1 + a code byte in {2, 3, 7, 9} on failure) and stores nowhere else except its own frame; of the six producer helpers, four (0x2761cd0, 0x2761fe0, 0x5490660, 0x5492440) produce the 0x118 record through their rdi out pointer, and two (0x5630000, 0x2aae850) are zero-store serialised-form inspectors mislabelled as producers upstream
